edge.title: The 40,000 km that were 90,000
edge.setup: A used car or two-wheeler, priced fairly, looks clean, owner seems decent. Odometer readings are trivially rolled back on digital clusters. The real history sits in records the seller hopes you won't pull.
edge.tell: Every claim is from the seller's mouth; none is from a record you fetched yourself.
move: Pull the service history from the manufacturer's network using the VIN — it carries true mileage at each service.
Check vahan.parivahan.gov.in for ownership count, insurance, and any hypothecation still live. A loan not closed means the bank, not the seller, effectively holds the papers.
Pay a trusted mechanic for a pre-purchase inspection. It's the highest-return ₹1,000 in the entire transaction.
Complete RC transfer within 14 days — until then, every challan and accident is legally yours.
edge.why: This is the market for lemons: the seller knows the car's history and you don't, so good cars get underpriced and bad ones oversold. Every fix works by converting the seller's private knowledge into a public record you can check yourself.
edge.variants: Same shape: refurbished phones with swapped batteries, 'single-owner' furniture, rental agreements hiding a pending dispute.

lens.name: Principal–agent problem
lens.one_line: The person acting for you is paid for something subtly different from what you want.
lens.detail: A broker is paid when a deal closes, not when you choose well. An insurance agent is paid on commission, which differs by product. A contractor is paid for the job, not for the job lasting. None of this requires bad intent — the incentive is enough. Knowing the pay structure predicts the advice better than knowing the person.
elsewhere: Fund managers judged quarterly take risks that look fine quarterly.
A politician's horizon is the next election; infrastructure's horizon is thirty years.
A mechanic paid per part replaced finds more parts to replace.
lens.test: Before weighing advice, ask: what exactly triggers this person getting paid?
lens.today: TOI reports a woman paid ₹1.03 crore for a 3BHK in Bengaluru and the builder then failed to provide the specially-enabled parking she was promised. A seller is paid at the sale, while the promise has to be honoured later, when he is no longer being paid for it. Get every such promise written into the agreement before you pay, not into a brochure or a conversation.

moved.what: Bengaluru police detained a man for extorting money from passengers at Kempegowda International Airport, per The Hindu.
moved.so_what: Pay only the app or prepaid-counter fare. A demand for extra cash at the kerb is not a negotiation: note the vehicle number and report it to the airport police.

moved.what: Bangalore Mirror reports flyover dirt on the ORR throwing riders off balance, and TOI says its report on a flyover death has prompted government action.
moved.so_what: If you ride a two-wheeler, treat flyover ramps and the left edge as loose-surface zones, even on dry days. Slow down before the ramp, not on it.

moved.what: About 2.8 lakh SIR hearings are still pending in Karnataka, with Bengaluru accounting for nearly two-thirds, per TOI.
moved.so_what: If you have a hearing notice, attend with your documents. If you are unsure of your status, check it on the electoral roll portal instead of assuming it is fine.

moved.what: APSRTC says it will run 5,261 special buses for Dasara, per ETV Bharat.
moved.so_what: If you are travelling to Andhra Pradesh for the festival, book now and compare with trains. A WhatsApp seat offered for a premium is not a booking.

moved.what: ET reports that Bengaluru's ₹1,500 airport cab rides could get cheaper as the Blue Line takes shape.
moved.so_what: The report does not give a date, so keep budgeting for cab fares to the airport. Do not change a rental or job decision for a line that has not opened.

carry_over.prompt: A video caller in police uniform says a case is open in your name, and tells you to stay on camera and tell nobody. What is the tell?
carry_over.answer: Any demand to stay on the line, stay on camera, or tell nobody is the attack itself.
